hints.content:
###The cost to make one sandwich

It costs the school band $S$ dollars per sandwich that they make.

###The profit the band earns from one sandwich

The band marks the sandwiches up by $20\%$ of the original cost $S$ to get their profit.

So the band earns a profit $20\% \cdot S$ dollars, which equals $0.2S$ dollars, on each sandwich they sell.

###The amount of money that the band receives for selling one sandwich

The band charges what it costs them to make the sandwich plus their intended profit for each sandwich. So the band receives $S+0.2S$ dollars per sandwich they sell.

###The number of sandwiches the the band sold

The band receives a total of $(S+0.2S)$ times the number of sandwiches they sell. 

Since $73(S+0.2S)$ describes how much money the school band received selling sandwiches at their last fundraiser, they must have sold $73$ sandwiches.

Situation | Expression
:- | :-:
The number of sandwiches the the band sold | $73$ 
The cost to make one sandwich | $S$
The profit the band earns from one sandwich | $0.2S$
The amount of money that the band receives for selling one sandwich | $S+0.2S$

question.content:
It costs the school band $S$ dollars per sandwich that they make. The band sells each sandwich for $20\%$ more than it costs to make so they earn a profit.

The expression $73(S+0.2S)$ describes how much money the school band received selling sandwiches at their last fundraiser.

**Match each amount in the situation with the expression that represents it.**  

[[☃ matcher 1]]

left: The number of sandwiches the band sold
The cost to make one sandwich
The profit the band earns from one sandwich
The amount of money that the band receives for selling one sandwich
